import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_excel('/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/subtotals.q5.codex.0/ws/monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
# header row at index 3
cols = df.iloc[3].tolist()
# rename
data = df.iloc[4:].copy()
data.columns = cols
# clean
data = data.rename(columns={cols[0]:'Transaction ID', cols[1]:'Date', cols[2]:'Programme', cols[3]:'District', cols[4]:'State', cols[5]:'Funding Source', cols[6]:'Expense Head', cols[7]:'Amount (INR)', cols[8]:'Remarks'})
# filter rows where Transaction ID starts with EXP-
def is_exp(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return False
    s=str(x).strip()
    return s.startswith('EXP-')
mask = data['Transaction ID'].apply(is_exp)
filtered = data[mask].copy()
filtered['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
print('rows', len(filtered))
total = filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
azim = filtered[filtered['Funding Source']=='Azim Premji Foundation']['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print('total', total)
print('azim', azim)
print('pct', azim/total*100)
\"
"
